title: 2.47 — the argument
description: Sanskrit and Telang side by side, with Śaṅkara, Tilak and Gandhi on the same twelve words. The three-second demonstration of what this system is for.

title: Letter-level readings
description: Where the tradition annotates single letters. Proof that letter granularity is inherited from the sources, not invented as a feature.

title: Dao De Jing 1 — metaphysics or medicine
description: Wang Bi and Heshang Gong on the same seven characters, with the Mawangdui witness underneath. Two commentaries, two different books.

title: Renunciation — Śaṅkara against the moderns
description: Īśā 1 with Śaṅkara and Aurobindo. The same argument as Gītā 2.47, between the same two positions, on a different text — which is why the corpus holds pairs.
